title: Zesty Dutch Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring tender beef, crunchy vegetables, and a zesty broth, served with crusty ciabatta bread for a perfect date-night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and dried thyme, and stir to combine.
Cover the claypot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Serve the stew hot, with crusty ciabatta bread on the side.
